+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import contextlib
+import io
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from ahra import cli
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+def _run_cli(argv: list[str], *, cwd: Path | None = None) -> tuple[int, dict, str]:
+    stdout = io.StringIO()
+    stderr = io.StringIO()
+    old_cwd = Path.cwd()
+    if cwd is not None:
+        os.chdir(cwd)
+    try:
+        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(stdout), contextlib.redirect_stderr(stderr):
+            code = cli.main(argv)
+    finally:
+        if cwd is not None:
+            os.chdir(old_cwd)
+    payload = json.loads(stdout.getvalue() or stderr.getvalue())
+    return code, payload, stderr.getvalue()
+
+
+class WorkflowAStartPathTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_start_creates_missing_workspace_artifact_and_store_parent(self) -> None:
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
+            root = Path(temp)
+            intent = ROOT / "examples" / "intents" / "phase1-example-intent.yaml"
+            session = root / "workflow-a" / "session.json"
+            workspace = root / "workflow-a" / "workspace"
+            artifacts = root / "workflow-a" / "artifacts"
+            store = root / "workflow-a" / "store" / "goal-control.sqlite3"
+
+            self.assertFalse(workspace.exists())
+            self.assertFalse(artifacts.exists())
+            self.assertFalse(store.parent.exists())
+
+            code, payload, _ = _run_cli(
+                [
+                    "workflow-a",
+                    "start",
+                    str(intent),
+                    "--session",
+                    str(session),
+                    "--workspace-ref",
+                    str(Path("workflow-a") / "workspace"),
+                    "--artifact-dir",
+                    str(Path("workflow-a") / "artifacts"),
+                    "--store-path",
+                    str(Path("workflow-a") / "store" / "goal-control.sqlite3"),
+                ],
+                cwd=root,
+            )
+
+            self.assertEqual(code, 0)
+            self.assertTrue(workspace.is_dir())
+            self.assertTrue(artifacts.is_dir())
+            self.assertTrue(store.parent.is_dir())
+            self.assertFalse(store.exists())
+            self.assertEqual(Path(payload["result"]["snapshot"]["workspaceRef"]), workspace.resolve())
+            self.assertEqual(Path(payload["result"]["snapshot"]["artifactDir"]), artifacts.resolve())
+            self.assertEqual(Path(payload["result"]["snapshot"]["storePath"]), store.resolve())
+
+    def test_start_fails_closed_with_structured_path_error(self) -> None:
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
+            root = Path(temp)
+            intent = ROOT / "examples" / "intents" / "phase1-example-intent.yaml"
+            session = root / "workflow-a" / "session.json"
+            workspace = root / "workspace-file"
+            workspace.write_text("not a directory\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+            code, payload, _ = _run_cli(
+                [
+                    "workflow-a",
+                    "start",
+                    str(intent),
+                    "--session",
+                    str(session),
+                    "--workspace-ref",
+                    str(workspace),
+                    "--artifact-dir",
+                    str(root / "artifacts"),
+                    "--store-path",
+                    str(root / "store" / "goal-control.sqlite3"),
+                ],
+                cwd=root,
+            )
+
+            self.assertEqual(code, 2)
+            self.assertFalse(payload["ok"])
+            self.assertEqual(payload["code"], "workflow_a_path_not_directory")
+            self.assertEqual(payload["path"], str(workspace.resolve()))
+            self.assertEqual(payload["pathRole"], "workspaceRef")
+            self.assertIn(str(workspace.resolve()), payload["error"])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
